content.what_it_is: EFDC의 전역 격자 및 고주파 지점 결과를 NetCDF4로 정의하고 기록하는 모듈이다. nc_var 기술자 표(L94-L261), 출력 플래그에 따른 변수 정의(L263-L301, L829-L989), UGRID/CF 격자 메타데이터와 좌표 기록(L303-L689), 지점 파일 정의(L691-L827), 배열 형상별 기록 함수(L1125-L1444), 물리·수질·퇴적·구조물·패류 결과 기록(L1446-L2043), 파일 생성·재개·종료 제어(L2045-L2118)를 포함한다.

verbatim_spans.text: integer,parameter :: ZERO = 0, ONE = 1, FOUR = 4, NC_VAR_CNT = 155, LEN_NAME = 20

unresolved: UGRID face-connectivity role is internally inconsistent: Mesh2D advertises `face_node_connectivity: Mesh2D_face_nodes` at L471, but Mesh2D_face_nodes itself uses misspelled `face_node_connnectivity` at L482, so consumers may not recognize its cf_role.

Sigma-Z metadata names a nonexistent/inconsistent depth coordinate: the IGRIDV branch writes `depth: Bottom` at L562, while the same file defines bottom elevation as BELV and the standard-sigma branch uses `depth: BELV` at L577.

The generic def_var routine always attaches coordinates `Mesh2D_face_y Mesh2D_face_x`, mesh `Mesh2D`, and grid_mapping `crs` at L1035-L1057. nc_create_hf_file defines only cell/col/row/lon/lat/name at L739-L770 and no Mesh2D or crs variables, then invokes def_time_vars at L774; high-frequency files therefore contain dangling coordinate, mesh, and grid-mapping references.

Inactive component counts are passed directly as fixed dimension lengths (NDYE, NTOX, NSED, NSND, NSEDS2, NALGAE, NZOOPL, NSF, NQCTL, NQWR) at L726-L736 and similarly in the full-grid creator at L443-L453. Since the NetCDF unlimited length is zero, any inactive count of zero can create unintended unlimited dimensions rather than an absent/zero-length class dimension; compatibility and downstream shapes are unresolved.

The RSSBC array is dimensioned for LCM_Global and filled through LCM_Global at L665-L679, then written with count LCM_Global-1 at L680, whereas CUV and the face mesh use nc.cellcnt/LA_Global-1 at L636-L672. If LCM_Global exceeds LA_Global, this write exceeds the defined face dimension or associates ghost cells with active faces.

For high-frequency output with IJHFRE(IS) other than zero, lon and lat remain MISSING_VALUE because coordinate assignment is wholly inside IJHFRE(IS)==0 at L790-L806, even though cell indices are populated unconditionally at L808-L814. The intended coordinate source for that mode is not present here.

nc_write_wc_2d initializes `values` only in the full-grid branch at L1247-L1254. In the high-frequency branch L1234-L1245, Sigma-Z layers below KSZ_Global are never assigned, so uninitialized memory is written for those layers.

nc_write_bed_2d writes rank-3 variables using str2d declared with length 2 at L1321 and set to `(1,time_idx)` at L1323, while cnt2d has three entries and includes KB at L1325/L1338. The layer start index is omitted, so HBED/BDENBED/PORBED writes at L1592-L1594 have a start/count interface mismatch.

LAYERACTIVE is stored as int2d(cell,KB) at L1626-L1635, but nf90_put_var is given count `(KB,nc.cellcnt,1)` at L1636. The first two dimensions are reversed relative to both the allocation and other cell-layer writers, causing a shape/count mismatch unless the two lengths happen to match.

In the non-LSEDZLJ exposed-bed branch, TOXB is defined through ncvar(30) with the bed-layer/component layout in def_time_vars at L932-L940, but only a cell-by-NTOX surface array is passed to nc_write_wc_2d at L1733-L1741. That helper loops its second index from KSZ_Global through KC at L1241-L1244, not 1 through NTOX, so it can index beyond array2d/values and cannot satisfy the bed variable rank.

All cell-by-shellfish-class variables 143-154 are passed to nc_write_wc_2d at L1901-L1975. That water-column helper allocates second extent NSF but loops k=KSZ_Global(L)..KC at L1241-L1244. When KC and NSF differ this reads/writes outside the class array or leaves class slots unset; these calls should use a class-oriented cell writer rather than a vertical-layer writer.

Wave dissipation is a copy/paste value error: array1d is filled from WV_Global(L).FREQ at L1567-L1569 immediately before writing variable 18 `Diss` at L1570. The same FREQ source was already used for peak period at L1563-L1565, so the dissipation variable receives frequency data with incompatible meaning/units.

The wave radiation-stress descriptors Sxx/Sxy/Syy are labelled W/m2 in the nc_var table at L117-L119, while the variables are populated directly from WVHUU_Global/WVHUV_Global/WVHVV_Global at L1571-L1573 without any documented conversion. Whether those source arrays actually have energy-flux units rather than radiation-stress units is unresolved and should be reconciled with their producers.

File-open state is not synchronized with actual close behavior. nc_close_file closes only when ncdfout>1 at L1080-L1088 but never clears isopen; nc_output and nc_output_hf always call it at L2088/L2117 and on the next call reopen whenever isopen==1 at L2060-L2062/L2108-L2109. For ncdfout<=1 this reopens an already-open file; for ncdfout>1 isopen continues to describe a closed handle.

At a date rollover in split-file mode, the `isopen==1` branch calls nc_write on nc(0) at L2075-L2077 before creating the new file. Under the ncdfout>1 path the preceding invocation closed that handle at L2088, so the rollover write targets a closed NetCDF id and can stop in a checked writer; under a persistent-open path it duplicates the transition timestep into the prior file before also writing it to the new file at L2087.

Most direct NetCDF operations in def_var and nc_write assign status without check_err (for example L1026-L1064, L1467-L1469, L1980-L2031), while helper-based writes stop on error. This inconsistent error contract can let failed definitions, attributes, time writes, or structure outputs proceed with invalid ids and surface only in later operations.
